name: uams-web/uams-2016
description: The UAMS 2016 WordPress theme. This file holds development dependencies only: nothing in it is installed on a site.

scripts-descriptions.lint:floor: Parse every shipped PHP file; run it under the PHP floor (8.2) to prove none uses newer syntax.
scripts-descriptions.setup:integration: Install the Integration suite's own Composer setup (PHPUnit 9.6, wp-phpunit, the polyfills).
scripts-descriptions.test: Run both suites, each in its own process, so the Unit suite never sees WordPress.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the Pest suite that needs no WordPress and no database.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the PHPUnit 9.6 suite that boots WordPress through wp-phpunit against the test database.
